propositions: Four zero-finding agentic criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) have produced zero findings across ~7,900 runs due to insufficient trigger vocabulary; an audit produced amended vocabularies achieving 84.0%/61.6%/86.5%/96.5% fire rates on 743 reviewed non-bug tickets.

Deterministic pre-filters (DetGateRule with text_all conjunctions, file_impact_globs, and file_impact_reason_re) skip criteria only when subject vocabulary is entirely absent, preserving LLM routing authority for fired plans per ADR 0034.

Overlay criteria (T13, T14) use _DET_OVERLAY_RULES in registry.py; leaf criteria (removal-rationale, asserted-capability) use _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES with a second gate block in orchestrator.route_criteria after the is_overlay guard.

Not-fired gates must record skip events in coverage.routing.det_gated (keyed by criterion id with rule name) to make skips visible in REVIEW_RESULT sidecars; the assemble step's route_criteria call is the single recording point to avoid duplicates.

asserted-capability fires only when both text_all legs (module-ref and capability-verb) match; removal-rationale detects removal intent via file_impact_reason_re matching against reason text when description text does not match.
T5a/T5d/T7/T12 existing regex entries migrate to DetGateRule one-element text_all tuples in a behavior-preserving conversion verified by unit tests.
